mapper.sql:
SELECT r.REQUEST_ID, r.USER_NO, r.CATEGORY_CODE, r.TITLE, r.CONTENT, r.SERVICE_ADDRESS, r.STATUS_CODE, r.CREATED_AT, cc.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, sc.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME, u.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ESTIMATES e WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID) AS ESTIMATE_COUNT,
(SELECT MAX(e2.ESTIMATE_ID) FROM ESTIMATES e2 WHERE e2.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID AND e2.FIXER_NO = #{userNo}) AS MY_ESTIMATE_ID FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS r JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = r.CATEGORY_CODE LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE sc ON sc.CODE_ID = r.STATUS_CODE
mapper.select:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.STATUS_CODE IN ('REQ_01', 'REQ_02', 'REQ_99')
AND r.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}
AND (r.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.REQUEST_ID DESC
SELECT PHOTO_ID, REQUEST_ID, PHOTO_PATH, PHOTO_TYPE, PHOTO_ORDER, CREATED_AT FROM REPAIR_PHOTO WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY PHOTO_ORDER, PHOTO_ID

SELECT r.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, r.USER_NO AS userNo, r.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, cc.CODE_NAME AS categoryName, r.TITLE AS title, r.CONTENT AS content, r.SERVICE_ADDRESS AS serviceAddress, r.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, sc.CODE_NAME AS statusName, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ESTIMATES e WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID) AS estimateCount FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS r LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = r.CATEGORY_CODE AND cc.CODE_GROUP = 'CATEGORY' AND cc.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE sc ON sc.CODE_ID = r.STATUS_CODE AND sc.CODE_GROUP = 'STATUS' AND sc.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE r.USER_NO = #{userId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, r.USER_NO AS userNo, r.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, cc.CODE_NAME AS categoryName, r.TITLE AS title, r.CONTENT AS content, r.SERVICE_ADDRESS AS serviceAddress, r.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, sc.CODE_NAME AS statusName, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS r LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = r.CATEGORY_CODE AND cc.CODE_GROUP = 'CATEGORY' AND cc.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE sc ON sc.CODE_ID = r.STATUS_CODE AND sc.CODE_GROUP = 'STATUS' AND sc.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND r.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT e.ESTIMATE_ID AS estimateId, e.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, e.FIXER_NO AS fixerNo, u.NAME AS fixerName, e.ESTIMATED_PRICE AS estimatedPrice, e.ESTIMATED_DURATION AS estimatedDuration, e.CONTENT AS content, e.STATUS AS status, e.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ESTIMATES e LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = e.FIXER_NO WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY e.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPAIR_REQUESTS ( USER_NO, CATEGORY_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, SERVICE_ADDRESS, STATUS_CODE, VISIT_DATE, VISIT_TIME_CODE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{categoryCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{serviceAddress}, NVL(#{statusCode}, 'REQ_01'), CASE WHEN #{visitDate} IS NULL OR #{visitDate} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{visitDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, #{visitTimeCode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE REPAIR_REQUESTS SET CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, SERVICE_ADDRESS = #{serviceAddress}, VISIT_DATE = CASE WHEN #{visitDate} IS NULL OR #{visitDate} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{visitDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, VISIT_TIME_CODE = #{visitTimeCode} WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND USER_NO = #{userNo} AND STATUS_CODE IN ('REQ_01', 'REQ_02', 'REQ_99')
mapper.select: SELECT e.ESTIMATE_ID AS estimateId, e.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, e.FIXER_NO AS fixerNo, u.NAME AS fixerName, e.ESTIMATED_PRICE AS estimatedPrice, e.ESTIMATED_DURATION AS estimatedDuration, e.CONTENT AS content, e.STATUS AS status, e.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ESTIMATES e LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = e.FIXER_NO WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND e.STATUS = 'SELECTED'
